en: Well, hello there, Trainer. A Pokédex too, I see. I'm a traveller. I wander the world and talk with whoever I meet.
Tell me, do you know of a Pokémon called Zoroark?
Then you know it can fool the eye. Good. Only be sure it never fools you.
No? Then mind yourself. The Pokémon you've never heard of is the easiest one to be fooled by.
Whether you trust what you see or doubt it all is your own choice. I've enjoyed our talk. Here, a keepsake.
They say a Zoroark came to this forest two years ago and dressed the grass and the trees in its illusions.
Only a rumour, of course. But there's always a grain of truth in a rumour...
The traveller was a Zoroark all along! It vanished into the trees.
